sentences.text: The Perth Casino Royal Commission examined whether the casino licensee and associated Crown companies were suitable to conduct casino gaming, and whether Western Australia’s regulation was adequate.

cites.document: Perth Casino Royal Commission, Final Report

sentences.text: The Commission found that the licensee was unsuitable to retain its licence and that the associated companies were unsuitable to organise or conduct casino gaming.
